text:
maya: Heads-up — onboarding sora-mini-v2 is hitting a tokenization mismatch in CI. Weights are at gs://redwood-models/sora-mini-v2/weights/v2-20260310/ and tokenizer is sora-bpe-v3. CI error: 'token_id 50256 not found' when running our chat templates. Anyone seen this?

sam: can you paste the exact config snippet you used? sounds like special-token mismatch.

maya: sure, copy/paste below:```
model: sora-mini-v2
weights_path: gs://redwood-models/sora-mini-v2/weights/v2-20260310/pytorch_model.bin
tokenizer: sora-bpe-v3
special_tokens: {bos: "", eos: "", pad: "<|pad|>"}
chat_template: "<<SYS>>{system}\n{user}\n{assistant}"
```CI run uses our standard chat template.

lee: I think that's it — bos/eos are empty strings. For some vocab builds '' maps to id 50256. We usually expect explicit tokens like `<s>` and `</s>`. Try setting bos: '<s>' eos: '</s>' and re-run.

maya: ah, I assumed empty was the default when loader falls back. re-running now with explicit tokens.

deploy-bot: CI job `sora-onboard-1765432100` failed (tokenizer-mapping-error) — logs: gs://ci-logs/sora-onboard/1765432100/err.log

jen: also confirm that `tokenizer.json` shipped with the weights commit. mismatch often happens when weights and vocab are from different commits. can you `ls` the bucket for tokenizer.json?

maya: found tokenizer.json at gs://redwood-models/sora-mini-v2/weights/v2-20260310/tokenizer.json — it actually contains "<s>" and "</s>". my local loader was defaulting to empty strings when missing fields. pushing a fix to prefer vocab tokens over loader defaults. PR shortly: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/421

sam: tiny follow-up: add a quick config validator in onboarding to error on empty special tokens when tokenizer vocab contains explicit entries. e.g. `if not cfg.special_tokens['bos']: raise ValueError('BOS token missing or empty')`

maya: will add `tests/onboard/test_tokenizer_sync.py` with a mock tokenizer.json check and a validator. @jen can you quick-review the PR when I open it? :pray:

jen: yep, will review today. :thumbsup:

sam: after merge, let's run a smoke generate using the chat_template to verify prefix/KV-caching behavior didn't regress. pinging runtime for a dev GPU run.

lee: I'll queue a small smoke run on the dev GPU pool once PR merges. note: switching BOS/EOS can shift tokenization boundaries and slightly affect token counts + batching heuristics — expect small perf variance but correctness should be fixed.

maya: thanks all — will follow up with PR link and CI green check.
